label: Patient roadmap and economic burden of chronic tick-borne illness and post-treatment Lyme disease syndrome in Ireland, and public health issues arising.
summary: Lyme borreliosis (LB), commonly referred to as Lyme disease (LD), is a prominent global health issue, exhibiting a seroprevalence rate of 14.5%. Heightened incidence levels of LD have been recorded in parts of Europe, Poland, Eastern Europe, and the Baltic States. The research aimed to inform the cost of LD and post-treatment Lyme disease syndrome (PTLDS) in Ireland through results from a patient questionnaire, disease modelling, the construction of a patient roadmap, and attempts to arrive at…
